task: Predict the archived received YES topquote midpoint at t+30min from information available by t;no tradability,profitability,market-outcome or news-value claim
population: All20fixed markets,all day grids,including unchanged endpoints. Complete-case errors conditional on observed valid history/forward;report missingness over all38640grids. No domain/segment dropping from primary analysis.

selection: Lowest selection-date MAE including persistence;ties choose persistence then listed order. Require>=100training rows,>=30selection rows from>=3markets else retain persistence.
metrics: matched paired MAE difference vs persistence
unchanged/changed target diagnostic reported,never used to select evaluation subsets
evaluation_status: Chronological development evaluation,not independent prospective confirmation;prior2h source coverage exposed on all dates. No retuning or segment retention based on evaluation wins.
inference: Seven days and dependent targets do not support strong significance claims;report descriptive effects,not naive row-level confidence intervals.
future_confirmation: Separate untouched block and source/target protocol required before confirmatory claim;not fetched by this task
execution_gate: Capture hashes and coverage QA must pass;minimum rows enforced before fitting;no automatic model promotion
